content: The forward and backward hidden states are concatenated to get the hidden state vectors of the tokens (i.e. $h_i = [\overrightarrow{h}_i; \overleftarrow{h}_i]$ ). The final states of the forward and backward GRU are also concatenated to create the final text representation vector of the encoder $s = [\overrightarrow{h}_n; \overleftarrow{h}_1]$ . These values are calculated per layer, where $x_t$ of the second layer is $h_t$ of the first layer. The final text representation vectors are projected by a fully connected layer and are passed to the decoder as the initial hidden states $s_0 = s$ .
